title: Horton 2025-03 Semifinal Kingdom 1: Way of the Mouse (Black Market), Cemetery, Devil's Workshop

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: March 2025 Tournament Summary; Semifinal Kingdom 1, designed and playtested by Horton

quality_note: Designer states his opening and build from playtesting and explains the Black Market deck's composition.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. Way of the Mouse's set-aside card is Black Market. The Black Market deck (prepared by the organizer) holds: Apprentice, Black Cat, Catacombs, Council Room, Crew, Envoy, Frigate, Guard Dog, Haunted Woods, Highwayman, Journeyman, Library, Magnate, Mapmaker, Margrave, Masquerade, Militia, Monkey, Ninja, Old Witch, Patrol, Pilgrim, Rabble, Rice Broker, Ronin, Scholar, Sea Witch, Sheepdog, Smithy, Stowaway, Torturer, Wharf, Witch's Hut. The Supply has no Action cards.
